name: Chuck Grassley

issue_poll.name: Des Moines Register/Mediacom Iowa Poll (Selzer & Co.), Oct 31–Nov 3, 2022 and Jul 10–13, 2022
issue_poll.note: Share calling each issue 'critical'. Nov poll (6 items) ranked first; remaining items from July poll likely voters (https://www.yahoo.com/news/iowa-poll-republicans-democrats-view-120513166.html). 'Party control of Congress' (Nov #1) left out as untestable. Ranks 9–10 drawn from July items all under 50% with no exact topline; order is a judgment.

issues.position: Oppose federal spending increases; cut spending

votes.bill_title: CRA disapproval of student loan cancellation
votes.question: On passage

issues.position: Leave abortion to states; vote no on national 15-week ban

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: No floor vote on a national abortion ban this term.

issues.position: Pass bipartisan prescription drug price reform
Permanently place fentanyl analogues in Schedule I
Oppose a federal gun registry; enforce existing gun laws
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on a gun registry or major gun bill this term.
Year-round E15 never reached a Senate floor vote this term.

issues.position: Reform the Electoral Count Act after the election
issues.note: Enacted in the Dec 2022 omnibus, before this term began.

issues.position: All-of-the-above energy; supports ethanol and biodiesel
Reauthorize the Child Care and Development Block Grant
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on CCDBG reauthorization this term.

caveats: Issue list combines the Nov and Jul 2022 Iowa Polls; climate change and child care (ranks 9–10) chosen from July items below 50% without exact toplines; school choice (30%) and LGBTQ policies ranked lower.

Fiscal Responsibility Act roll call number not confirmed (Grassley's Yea is from his own release); Grassley's individual votes on H.R.4, H.J.Res.45 and S.4554 inferred from party-line reporting, not a member list.
Abortion rated on the S.4554 vote as a test of 'leave it to states'; the national ban he pledged to oppose never got a vote.
